title: Grateful Dead Live at University Auditorium, U. Arizona on 1969-04-11
lineage: SBD > MC > C > D > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Decent soundboard with hiss and missing sections, but showcases a rare Main Ten jam inside Dark Star and a monster Cryptical > It's A Sin.
ai_review.review: The recording is mostly clear but suffers from hiss in the middle of Dark Star, a cut where The Other One should be, and overall degraded tape quality. Musically the show shines with an early‑era Main Ten jam tucked into Dark Star, a powerhouse Cryptical > It's A Sin, spirited Hard to Handle featuring Pigpen vocals and slide work, plus a lively Lovelight rave‑up, making it a standout ’69 performance despite its gaps.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers praise the musical moments (average ~4.5) while noting moderate recording flaws (~3), yielding a weighted average around 4.0; four detailed reviews give high confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally good sound but noticeable hiss in Dark Star, degraded tape mid‑set and missing portions (The Other One cut).

show_quality.setlist_flow: A solid ’69 set with a rare Main Ten jam embedded in Dark Star and strong mid‑set energy, though the missing sections interrupt continuity.
